property_summary: For any two deposits by the same actor, the reference C accumulates so that Acc(actor).balance equals the sum of the deposited amounts, while the buggy M overwrites the balance so it only equals the last deposit, violating the accumulation rule for some inputs.
change_summary: Replace `acc.balance += msg.value;` with `acc.balance = msg.value;` so the deposit overwrites instead of accumulating, changing the stored balance observable via Acc(msg.sender).
